development_origin.description: DAILY_NON_CHASING_2PCT was selected after a read-only morphology audit and a post-hoc exact-capacity replay over consumed 2018-2021 V28R2 evidence. It is a candidate, not an independently discovered or validated edge.

concentration_risk.disclosure: The development frequency threshold is only barely cleared and depends heavily on one crowded 2018 signal date. Validation must report signal-date concentration and must not treat clustered names as independent confirmations.

parent.clarification: V29R3 is exactly V28R2 plus one contemporaneous price non-chasing gate. It does not inherit V29R1 or V29R2 issuer-risk selection, event taxonomy, cooldown, announcement keys, or titles.

single_additional_gate.name: DAILY_NON_CHASING_2PCT
single_additional_gate.signal_stock_return: raw signal-day close / raw signal-day preclose - 1; no adjustment, rounding, clipping, winsorization, or use of any later bar
single_additional_gate.market_universe: Every symbol row present in the exact registered CY-033 partition on the signal trade_date; no current-survivor, board, industry, index-member, liquidity, ST, return-sign, or outcome filter. The signal stock remains in the cross-section when eligible.
market_row_eligibility: trade_date equals the completed signal date
current_day_data_tradable is true and trade_status equals 1
available_at is non-null and no later than the signal decision timestamp
decision_at is non-null and no later than the signal decision timestamp
close and preclose are finite and strictly positive
single_additional_gate.aggregation: Unweighted exact cross-sectional median across all eligible rows. For an even count, use the arithmetic mean of the two central ordered values, matching pandas/DuckDB continuous median semantics.
single_additional_gate.signal_row_eligibility: The exact symbol/signal_date row must exist exactly once and satisfy every market-row eligibility condition.
single_additional_gate.missing_invalid_or_unknown: Reject the signal. Missing signal row, duplicate symbol-date, missing/empty snapshot_id, invalid/nontradable signal state, nonpositive price, nonfinite return, no eligible market rows, or any availability after the signal decision fails closed.

validation_window.run_count: ONE exact 2022-2024 temporal challenge after Stage A identity freeze and separate Stage B authorization

allowed_reads_after_protocol_freeze: the exact frozen V28R2 validation identity JSON
the exact frozen V28R2 validation selected-identity Parquet
only the exact CY-033 2022, 2023 and 2024 partitions referenced by registered outcome-blind wrapper CY-040
prohibited_reads: strategy outcomes, exits, targets, portfolio ledgers, NAV, reports or result summaries
announcement titles, announcement documents or issuer-risk classifier outputs
required_outputs: all parent identities with signal-time feature eligibility and rejection reason
a Stage-A freeze binding protocol, runner, wrapper asset, registry authorization, parent identity, source partitions and selected cohort hashes

stage_b.purpose: One fixed-cohort outcome attachment and exact capacity replay
stage_b.precondition: Verify the immutable Stage-A freeze and selected cohort before resolving, hashing, opening, or summarizing any 2022-2024 outcome source.
authorization_must_bind: this preregistration and exact runner hash
the completed Stage-A freeze and V29R3 selected cohort hashes
the exact V28R2 validation outcome and execution-daily sources
stage_b.identity_join: Attach outcomes only for exact Stage-A-selected gap_id values whose parent entry_status is EXECUTABLE_ENTRY; require one-to-one conservation and reject extras, duplicates or omissions.
stage_b.outcome_source_before_precondition: MUST NOT BE RESOLVED, HASHED, OPENED OR SUMMARIZED

unchanged_execution.entry: V28R2 frozen next legal one-minute entry strictly after the completed signal; no fill inside signal bar
unchanged_execution.cost: 20 basis points per side, 40 basis points round trip
unchanged_execution.portfolio: Main and ChiNext 50/50 sleeves; K80 per sleeve
unchanged_execution.trading_status_price_limits_corporate_ac: Preserve the frozen V28R2 fail-closed semantics exactly

required_overall_statistics: true capacity accepted count and accepted per signal year
evaluation.required_yearly_statistics: The same statistics for each of 2022, 2023 and 2024, including zero-trade years.
required_dependence_diagnostics: largest signal-date accepted count and share
descriptive rerun after removing the largest signal-date cluster without changing any rule
evaluation.no_rescue: No threshold, cohort, year, board, rank, target, stop, horizon, cost, K, missing-data treatment or market-universe change may be chosen after outcomes are opened.

governance.registry_requirement: Stage A must fail closed unless CY-040 and its one-to-one bounded authorization are present and exact. Stage B must fail closed until a separate exact bounded authorization is registered after Stage A freeze.
